title: A First-Timer's Guide to Ordering an Agbada
excerpt: Ordering your first agbada set can feel unfamiliar if you've only ever bought Western tailoring. Here's what to expect.
author: Lipek Fashion Team
body: An agbada is a three-piece set: an inner shirt (buba), trousers (sokoto) and the flowing outer robe (agbada) that gives the set its name. Each piece is measured and fitted separately, then styled together.
The outer robe is intentionally wide through the arms and body — this is traditional, not a fit error, though we can adjust drape and length to a level of fullness you're comfortable with.
Embroidery placement around the neckline is one of the most personal choices in the order. We show swatches of embroidery density and pattern before committing to the final design.
Most first-time clients order for a wedding or naming ceremony. We recommend starting the process at least three weeks out to allow time for embroidery and two fittings.
